11+ Non-Verbal Reasoning

Before you begin

Each question is worth one mark. Unless a question says “select two”, choose one answer. There is no penalty for a wrong answer.

Full exam simulation: a newly generated 80-question mixed non-verbal and spatial-reasoning paper is created before the 50-minute practice timer begins. You may move between questions and flag items.

Adaptive skills practice: up to 25 questions are generated one at a time. Lock each answer to continue. There is no backtracking because each response changes the internal practice level used next.

Untimed learning practice: a newly generated 25-question mixed set with complete visual-rule and worked-answer review after finishing.

Important: England does not use one universal 11+ syllabus or one fixed NVR paper format. This independent tool therefore practises the broad visual-reasoning competencies commonly used across selective-entry testing rather than claiming to reproduce one provider, school or authority paper. Timings, section combinations and delivery formats vary. Scores and adaptive levels here are raw internal practice measures—not age-standardised scores, psychometric assessments, admissions predictions or guarantees. No official questions, artwork, endorsement or affiliation are claimed.

New here? Start with Untimed learning practice to learn the controls and read the worked visual rules before attempting the timed simulation.

What this practice covers
Figure series and changing patternsVisual analogies and paired rules2×2 and 3×3 matricesOdd one out and classificationShape machines and coded transformationsRotation, reflection and symmetryPaper folding, cube nets, labelled tower counting and block viewsOverlays, hidden figures and line composition

Question attributes include shape, position, direction, angle, number, size, shading, markers, overlap, symmetry and spatial arrangement. Full simulation uses five-option single-answer questions; learning and adaptive modes may also use select-two questions.

A paper using your selected balance is created before the timer starts. Displayed educational tasks are checked against this paper and one shared retained history across full, learning and adaptive modes. New tasks are used while the protected validated bank and freshness search can supply them. If a completely fresh paper cannot be generated, the practice will not start; protected questions are not silently repeated.

Response-driven practice with no backtracking. Each locked response updates the next internal difficulty band.

Recommended first. Finish the set, then review every diagram with the rule and worked answer.

Progress is saved only in this browser on this device. Finishing or deleting a practice removes the saved attempt.
